messages:
alex: Heads-up — need 2x LGTM for PR #4871 (mem leak fix) before the 09:30 UTC hotfix cutoff. CI green but this touches allocator code, so manual approvals required. https://git.company/pr/4871

jordan: on my queue, can review in ~8m. will focus on the allocator diffs.

lina: @alex quick Q — does this require a migration or config change on deploy?
alex: no migrations. only runtime behavior change, no config. staging smoke passed.

sam: glanced at the change, looks safe but want to run the small perf test locally. will post results in 10.

ci-bot: All checks passed — unit: 245/245, integration: 78/78, e2e: 12/12.

marie: prioritizing this — will review now. if it's small and tests are good we can approve.

jordan: left a couple of comments about edge-case null handling, small nits. tagging @lina for the allocator behavior question.

lina: replied to jordan's comment — the path is already guarded, looks okay. approve from me once the null checks are explicit.

sam: perf run done — regression <0.5% p95, looks fine. approving now. :thumbsup:

marie: approve from me too. one minor doc nit.

alex: Thanks — that's 2x LGTM. I'll queue the merge and deploy to prod-hotfix after a 5m buffer.

devops-bot: Noted — scheduling deploy window 09:35-09:45 UTC. Will run canary at 09:36.

alex: Deploy queued. If anyone sees errors after canary ping here immediately.

devops-bot: Canary completed: no errors in 30s window, traffic ramp to 100% in progress.

alex: merged and promoted. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
